sentences.text: This end-of-well review covers wellbore 15/9-F-12 on the Volve field, and it is written from general knowledge of the field without access to the wellbore's daily reports, activity log or survey data.

Because no figures were pulled from the source data, this review states no hole sizes, depths, dates, durations, rates or volumes, and each of those should be taken from the approved well records before the review is relied on.
The hole-section layout of 15/9-F-12 should be confirmed against the casing and drilling programme for the well, including the hole size, start and end measured depth and casing shoe of each section.
Any new hole drilled in each section should be reconciled against the section boundaries in the final well record so that interval totals agree with the recorded total depth.
Drilling performance for the well should be assessed section by section, comparing achieved rate of penetration with the plan and separating drilling time from non-productive and lost time.
Lost time should be reviewed by primary and possible tier and by operation code, so that the largest contributors to non-productive time are identified and the causes recorded against them.

The operational timeline, including spud, section starts and ends, completion and the division of the well into operational campaigns, should be rebuilt from the daily reports and checked for gaps or overlapping reports.

Before the review is closed, the hole-section table, the lost-time breakdown and the campaign timeline should each be checked against the source records and the figures inserted with their supporting evidence.
Lessons on section sequencing, casing points and recurring lost-time causes should be carried into the planning of later wells in the same area of the field.
